$comment: The builtin tag vocabulary, as data.
This was a `const COMPONENTS: &[Builtin]` compiled into the binary. Moving it here is the same
argument `guml-codegen::theme` makes about the class table: a vocabulary written into a compiler
is a vocabulary nobody can inspect, diff or publish. It also means the builtin registry now
travels the *same* load path a third-party package does, which is the strongest available test
of that path — if `from_json` ever regresses, every builtin tag disappears and 400 tests say so.
`level` defaults to `core`, so an entry that omits it is markup. `children`, `slots`,
`capabilities` and `since` are all optional and default to the permissive answer.
Adding an entry here also requires a line in `crates/guml-compiler/tests/stability.rs`, a theme
rule in `crates/guml-codegen/themes/slate.json`, its CSS in `slate.css`, and lowering in each
backend. Tests fail on each omission — that is deliberate.

components.name: card
components.doc: Bordered surface grouping related content. Optional title as first positional.

components.name: row
components.doc: Horizontal layout. Use `center`/`between` to align instead of flex utilities.

components.name: col
components.doc: Vertical layout.

components.name: section
components.doc: Page section. Takes an optional #anchor and a title positional.

components.name: nav
components.doc: Top navigation bar. First positional is the brand name.

components.name: hero
components.doc: Above-the-fold block: headline, subcopy, calls to action.

components.name: footer
components.doc: Page footer. First positional is the copyright line.

components.name: form
components.doc: Submits on enter and on its primary button; its action runs on submit.

components.name: tier
components.doc: Pricing tier. Positionals: name, price, blurb. Children are perk lines.

components.name: faq
components.doc: Accordion. Each child line is `question | answer`.

components.name: tabs
components.doc: Segmented control bound to an enumerated state; options come from its domain.

components.name: h
components.doc: Section heading.

components.name: h1
components.doc: Page headline. One per page.

components.name: h2
components.doc: Subheading.

components.name: p
components.doc: Paragraph of prose.

components.name: text
components.doc: Inline text, usually a binding inside a repeater.

components.name: metric
components.doc: Large single number, for counters and KPI tiles.

components.name: head
components.doc: Page header line; may include a binding for a live count.

components.name: empty
components.doc: Empty-state message for the enclosing repeater.

components.name: btn
components.doc: Button. First positional is the label; `>` gives the action.

components.name: link
components.doc: Navigational link to a /route or #anchor.

components.name: check
components.doc: Checkbox bound to a boolean; its action runs on change.

components.name: toggle
components.doc: On/off switch bound to a boolean.

components.name: input
components.doc: Text field bound to a state name given as the first positional.

components.name: select
components.doc: Dropdown bound to an enumerated state; options come from its domain or `option` children.

components.name: list
components.doc: Renders one child template per item of a resource. Loading, empty and error states are compiled in.

components.name: table
components.doc: Tabular repeater; children describe one row.

components.name: slot
components.doc: Inside a `def` body, the place a call's children are inserted. Meaningless elsewhere.

components.$comment: --- 0.2: the production vocabulary. Every entry below lowers completely in at least the React, JSON and Svelte backends; the ones needing a runtime say so, and the no-JavaScript `html` backend reports them rather than emitting dead markup.
components.name: option
components.doc: One choice inside a `select`. The line remainder is the visible label.

components.name: note
components.doc: Secondary prose: a hint, a caption, or fine print.

components.name: badge
components.doc: Small inline status pill. First positional is the label; `danger`/`primary`/`quiet` set the tone.
$note: `container` rather than `text`, and it is the one kind correction in 0.2.
As a text tag its remainder was prose taken verbatim, so `badge danger Breaking` rendered the
string 'danger Breaking' — with no diagnostic, while this entry's own doc told a model to use
those very modifiers for tone and `themes/slate.json` carried three tone rules keyed on them.
Both were unreachable. The theme rules fire now, and `GUML0102` warns for the rest of the text
kind, where the verbatim rule stays and is correct.

components.name: divider
components.doc: Horizontal rule separating groups. Takes no content.

components.name: avatar
components.doc: Round identity chip. The line remainder is the person's name, shown as initials.

components.name: img
components.doc: Image. `src` is the URL; `alt` is mandatory and describes it.

components.name: skeleton
components.doc: Placeholder block shown while content loads. Takes no content.

components.name: step
components.doc: One stage inside a `stepper`. The line remainder is its label.

components.name: alert
components.doc: Prominent message the reader must not miss. Use `danger` for errors.

components.name: grid
components.doc: Equal-width grid. `cols=3` sets the column count; it collapses on small screens.

components.name: sidebar
components.doc: Secondary column beside the main content.

components.name: toolbar
components.doc: Row of controls acting on the content below it.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.doc: Trail of ancestor links. Children are `link`s, last one is the current page.

components.name: pagination
components.doc: Page navigation controls for a long list.

components.name: stepper
components.doc: Ordered progress through stages. Children are `step` lines.

components.name: menu
components.doc: Vertical list of actions or destinations.

components.name: stat
components.doc: KPI tile. Positionals: label then value; `delta` is the change to show beneath.

components.name: progress
components.doc: Determinate progress bar. `value` and `max` are numbers or bindings.

components.name: modal
components.doc: Dialog over the page, shown while `if=` is true. First positional is its title.

components.name: drawer
components.doc: Panel sliding in from the edge, shown while `if=` is true. First positional is its title.

components.name: toast
components.doc: Transient notification, shown while `if=` is true. Announced politely.
